summary.text: PLA Silk is a silk-effect PLA with a glossy, satin-like surface. Makers sell it for decorative pieces, jewelry and artistic models. It is amorphous as printed, so it softens at its glass transition: its HDT at 0.45 MPa is 55 °C, and across the layers it keeps 30 % of its flat tensile strength. On the H2C it needs no heated chamber, and makers advise drying before printing.
